description: A team's own progress over time: items Resolved, cycle time, reviews, predictability and scope churn. Pick one team and compare it with itself only; not for comparing or ranking teams.

panels.description: Work items linked to merged PRs that this team moved to Resolved in the selected range.

Story points: this team's own trend

panels.description: Story points of the items moved to Resolved each week (bars) and the trailing 4-week average (line). Points are the estimate when the item was resolved, counted once per work item; items without an estimate add nothing (see the stat on the right of the sprint panel). Compare only with this team's own earlier weeks; teams are not comparable with each other. With Team = All the points of all teams are added up; point scales differ between teams, so read that only as total volume and never to compare teams.

targets.oDataQueryString: ADOTelemetry.ADOWorkItemFlowTyped?$apply=filter(('__all' in (${Organization:singlequote}) or Organization in (${Organization:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Project:singlequote}) or Project in (${Project:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Team:singlequote}) or Team in (${Team:singlequote})) and Resolved ne null and Resolved ge ${__from:date:seconds} and Resolved lt ${__to:date:seconds})/groupby((WorkItemId,Resolved),aggregate(StoryPointsCounted with sum as Points))&$top=20000

panels.title: Merge to Resolved per week

targets.oDataQueryString: ADOTelemetry.ADOWorkItemFlowTyped?$apply=filter(('__all' in (${Organization:singlequote}) or Organization in (${Organization:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Project:singlequote}) or Project in (${Project:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Team:singlequote}) or Team in (${Team:singlequote})) and Merged ne null and Merged ge ${__from:date:seconds} and Merged lt ${__to:date:seconds} and TimeToFirstApproval ne null)/groupby((PullRequestId,Merged,TimeToFirstApproval,ApprovalToMerge))&$top=20000

panels.title: Review flow per week of merge

panels.description: Items that were in a sprint when their PR was created (planned) and those Resolved/Closed without moving to another sprint (delivered). Caveat: carry-over counts any iteration move, so delivery is understated. Compare only with this team's own earlier weeks; teams are not comparable with each other. Needs one team selected (sprint calendars differ between teams, so there is no All view).

defaults.noValue: Select one team: sprint calendars differ between teams, so sprints cannot be combined.

ADOTelemetry.ADOWorkItemFlowTyped?$apply=filter(('__all' in (${Organization:singlequote}) or Organization in (${Organization:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Project:singlequote}) or Project in (${Project:singlequote})) and Team in (${Team:singlequote}) and InitialIterationPath ne null and Merged ge ${__from:date:seconds} and Merged lt ${__to:date:seconds} and CarriedOver eq 0 and (State eq 'Resolved' or State eq 'Closed'))/groupby((InitialIterationPath),aggregate(WorkItemId with countdistinct as Delivered))&$top=20000
